settings.question: What is Kratom?
settings.answer: Kratom is the leaf of Mitragyna speciosa, a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia that belongs to the Rubiaceae (coffee) botanical family. For generations, farmers and villagers harvested the leaves to chew during long workdays for clean physical stamina and in the evening to relax in good spirits. The leaf contains natural botanical alkaloids, primarily mitragynine. Dandy takes mature leaves, extracts the pure mitragynine, and portions it into an exact 35 mg gummy so you know what you are getting every single time.

settings.question: Is Kratom legal?
settings.answer: Yes. Kratom is 100% federally legal in the United States. Furthermore, a growing number of states have enacted Kratom Consumer Protection Acts (KCPA). These state laws specifically protect safe consumer access by establishing strict legal standards for third-party laboratory testing, accurate labeling, clean manufacturing, and age verification (21+). Dandy is fully compliant with all state consumer protection statutes nationwide.

settings.question: How is Dandy different from smoke-shop “7-OH” and synthetic products?
settings.answer:
This is the most critical distinction in the botanical world today. Many gas stations and smoke shops sell “7-OH” (7-hydroxymitragynine) products. In nature, 7-OH only exists in tiny fractions of a percent in raw leaves. Isolating or chemically synthesizing 7-OH into concentrated pills creates unpredictable, intense chemical highs and severe crashes.

Dandy never touches isolated 7-OH or synthetic chemicals. We use pure, unadulterated whole-leaf extract standardized to mitragynine, the natural, gentle, uplifting primary compound found in traditional leaves. Dandy is whole-plant wellness with zero synthetics.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: When you choose a subscription, you lock in a 20% discount and receive free shipping on all 2-pouch and 3-pouch deliveries. Your fresh batch arrives automatically every 30, 60, or 90 days. You have complete control: you can skip an upcoming order, adjust your delivery interval, pause, or cancel at any time directly in your account or with a quick email to support@foreverdandy.com. No contracts, no fees, no hassle.

settings.question: How much should I take?
settings.answer: If you are new to Dandy, start with half a gummy (approx. 17.5 mg mitragynine). Cut it in half with a knife, chew thoroughly, and give it a full 45 minutes on a light stomach. Most people find that half a gummy provides bright, cheerful focus for work or beating the afternoon slump. A full gummy provides deeper social euphoria and physical relaxation. Do not exceed 2 gummies in a single 24-hour period.

settings.question: Can Kratom become habit-forming?
settings.answer: Just like coffee, energy drinks, alcohol, or THC, responsible adults know that anything that makes you feel good should be enjoyed with intention. If you take large amounts every single day, your body will naturally build a tolerance. That is why we recommend using Dandy thoughtfully: start with half a gummy, keep your serving consistent, and take 2 to 3 days off each week to keep your sensitivity fresh and clean.

settings.question: Will this show up on a standard workplace drug test?
settings.answer: Mitragynine is chemically distinct from opioids, amphetamines, THC, and benzodiazepines. Standard 5-panel, 10-panel, and 12-panel workplace drug screens, such as the standard SAMHSA 5, do not test for kratom alkaloids. While specialized commercial tests for kratom exist, standard employment screenings look for illicit narcotics and controlled substances, not legal Southeast Asian botanicals.

settings.question: Is every batch independently lab tested?
settings.answer: Yes, without exception. Every production run is crafted in an FDA-registered American facility and sent to an accredited third-party laboratory. They test for exact mitragynine potency (guaranteed 35 mg per gummy), zero synthetic adulterants, heavy metals (lead, arsenic, cadmium, mercury), residual solvents, and microbials. Every pouch carries its lot number on the back, and you can inspect the Certificate of Analysis anytime.

settings.question: Who should not take Dandy?
settings.answer: Dandy is strictly formulated for responsible adults aged 21 and older. Do not use Dandy if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or nursing. If you have an existing medical condition or take prescription medications, speak with your healthcare provider prior to use.
